verdict.rationale: WezTerm is a terminal emulator and multiplexer, and a background-automation feature is a fair thing to ask of such a tool, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only building blocks: a daemonized headless mux server, CLI primitives (spawn, send-text, get-text, list) and Lua `wezterm.on` event callbacks. A user could script automations from these, but there is no documented WezTerm feature for setting up automations that run on their own, such as recurring schedules or autonomous task runners.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
